explanation: The first Globe burned down in 1613 when a stage cannon set its thatched roof alight during a performance of Henry VIII. A reconstruction opened near the site in 1997.

claims.text: The Globe Theatre in London was built in 1599 and staged many of Shakespeare's plays.
The Old Vic, the London Palladium and the Lyceum Theatre were all built long after 1599.
The original Globe burned down in 1613 when a cannon fired during a performance of Henry VIII set its thatched roof alight.
A reconstruction, Shakespeare's Globe, opened close to the original site in 1997.
